time.today: A moment earlier today, in lists of what happened. {time} is the time of day, already formatted for the language (15:25).
time.yesterday: A moment yesterday. {time} as in time.today.
time.dayAt: A moment on an earlier day. {day} is the day and month, already formatted for the language (Nov 20); {time} the time of day.
time.range: A span of days, as on a chart of weeks. {from} and {to} are days formatted as in time.dayAt.
deadline.over: A posting's application deadline has passed. Shown in a small badge next to the posting.
deadline.todayAt: The deadline is later today. {time} is when (23:59). Small badge.
deadline.tomorrow: The deadline is tomorrow (by the calendar, however few hours away). Small badge.
deadline.daysLeft: Days until the deadline, by the calendar; {n} is 2 or more. Plural forms separated by |, in the order of the language's plural categories (one | other for English). Small badge.
todos.deadline.past: On a to-do card about something with a deadline (an assessment, a reply): its deadline has passed.
todos.deadline.today: On a to-do card: its deadline is today.
todos.deadline.left: On a to-do card: days until its deadline; {n} is 1 or more. Plural forms as in deadline.daysLeft.
language.beta: In the language picker, next to a language whose translation is not complete yet. {name} is the language's own name.
analytics.change.same: Under a figure on the analytics page: it is the same as in the period of the same length before.
analytics.change.diff: Under a figure on the analytics page: how it changed against the period of the same length before. {change} is a signed percentage, already formatted (+20%, -15%).
todos.due.past: On a to-do card, after its due date (an interview, an assessment): the date has passed. Lower case: it follows the date after a dot (Nov 20 · overdue).
todos.due.today: On a to-do card, after its due date: it is today. Lower case, as todos.due.past.
analytics.first.title: Title of a card on the analytics page (job search results): time from a posting to the first record of its application that is ready to be sent.
analytics.first.explain: Help text behind the (i) of the card analytics.first.title.
analytics.first.sub: Under the title analytics.first.title: how many applications the figures are about.
analytics.first.fromFound: Label under a big figure (a duration).
analytics.first.fromBegun: Label under a big figure (a duration).
analytics.first.slow: Small line under analytics.first.fromFound: how many applications waited more than three days from finding to the first record. Plural forms as usual.
analytics.backlog.title: Title of a card on the analytics page: how long the cards on the to-do page wait before they are dealt with.
analytics.backlog.explain: Help text behind the (i) of analytics.backlog.title.
analytics.backlog.kind: Table column: the kind of to-do card (answer a question, approve a record, sign in…).
analytics.backlog.handled: Table column: how many cards of that kind were dealt with.
analytics.backlog.median: Table column: median time those cards waited.
analytics.backlog.oldest: Small heading over a list of the oldest open to-do cards, each with how long it has waited.
analytics.missed.why: Before a row of tags that count why good postings were missed (analytics.missed.reason.*).
analytics.missed.due: Under a missed posting: its deadline. {day} is a formatted date.
analytics.missed.reason.no_link: Why a good posting was not applied for before its deadline: the posting had no link to apply at. Lower case, a tag.
analytics.missed.reason.not_started: Why a good posting was missed: no application was begun for it.
analytics.missed.reason.waited_for_you: Why a good posting was missed: its application waited for the applicant (an answer, an approval, a sign-in).
analytics.missed.reason.failed: Why a good posting was missed: its application failed.
analytics.missed.reason.under_way: Why a good posting was missed: its application was still being worked when the deadline passed.
analytics.missed.reason.withdrawn: Why a good posting was missed: the applicant withdrew the application.
analytics.asked.title: Title of a card on the analytics page (automation): form questions the applicant had to answer in several applications.
analytics.asked.explain: Help text behind the (i) of analytics.asked.title.
analytics.asked.question: Table column.
analytics.asked.times: Table column: in how many applications it was asked.
analytics.asked.remember: Button in a row: saves the question with the answer into the applicant's profile as a standard answer.
analytics.asked.inProfile: Tag in a row instead of the button analytics.asked.remember: the profile already has this answer.
analytics.unknown.title: Title of a card on the analytics page (automation): applications where Submit was pressed but it was not seen whether they went out.
analytics.unknown.explain: Help text behind the (i) of analytics.unknown.title.
analytics.unknown.median: Label under a big figure (a duration).
analytics.unknown.open: Label under a big figure (a count), followed by the oldest of them with how long they have waited.
